name: B10-0069/2026 (The Left) – Brutal repression against protesters in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Iran's violent crackdown on protesters since late December 2025, including killings, mass arrests and internet shutdowns. It asks Iran to stop using deadly force, release people detained for protesting, restore internet access and allow independent investigations. It also calls on the European Union to lift sanctions that harm ordinary Iranians, and urges the United States and Israel to stop interfering in Iran's affairs. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament calls for investigations and for Iran to stop lethal force; nothing changes on the ground yet.
- It asks the European Union to lift sanctions harming civilians; this affects Iranians' access to medicine and goods.
- It urges the United States and Israel to stop interfering; the text is forwarded to governments but is not binding.
